Boston Bar
Welcome to Boston Bar, BC Boston Bar is a small town at the heart of the Fraser Canyon in British Columbia, Canada. It was named by the indigenous people after the Americans ( Boston men ) who panned for gold on the local sand bars of the Fraser River during the Gold Rush of the 1800s. For more information about the Boston Bar area, visit the Boston Bar-North Bend Enhancement Society website .

pages.title: Cabins & Rooms – Old Towne Inne
pages.text:
Cabins Rooms Old Towne Inne
Skip to content
Old Towne Inne features four self-contained cabins, as well as three additional rooms with shared bathroom facilities above the restaurant.
Each cabin has cable TV, kitchen facilities, and a private bathroom. One cabin has a built-in jacuzzi.
Check-In:
3pm 8pm
Check-Out:
11am
Children/Extra Beds:
Up to three children under 6 years are charged CAD $10 per night when using existing beds. There is no capacity for extra beds in the room. Supplements are not calculated automatically in the total costs and will have to be paid for separately when checking out.
Pets:
Pets are allowed on request. Charges may be applicable.
Daily Cleaning:
Our Cottages are all rough cedar interior walls & we clean them throughout daily. Unfortunately because of the rough cedar they will collect a small amount of dust and cobwebs immediately. It s the country!
Free WiFi:
WiFi is secured. Password is supplied at time of registration if requested.
Accepted Credit Cards:
Visa, Euro/Mastercard. We reserve the right to pre-authorize credit cards prior to arrival. You must show a valid photo ID and credit card upon check-in.
Enjoy and have fun!
SitASpell
